thread:
ben_infra: Heads-up — proposing a unified metrics + dashboard effort for KV + prefix cache effectiveness. Need runtime, infra/ingest, observability, console, and product aligned on metrics, labels, ownership. Who wants to own what?

maria_platform: Thanks — can you list the exact metrics you want to start with? My guess: hit_rate, eviction_rate, reuse_by_workload, cache_size, ttl distribution, and maybe per-request latency.

alex_runtime: We can emit basic counters/gauges from the runtime: 
- kv_cache.requests_total
- kv_cache.hits_total
- kv_cache.evictions_total
- kv_cache.size_gauge
- prefix_cache.requests_total
- prefix_cache.reuses_total{workload=...,model=...,route=...}
We'll try to keep labels minimal: workload and model_version. Avoid user_id or per-customer labels at emit-time (too high-cardinality).

joni_obs: +1 on labels. From infra/obs side we prefer canonical label names: 'workload', 'model', 'route', and an optional 'tier' (free/prod/enterprise/canary). We'll compute derived series in the pipeline (e.g., hit_rate = hits/requests) and add histograms for cache op latencies. Also add a gauge for eviction_rate (evictions_total delta / time).

olivia_product: Product note: stakeholders want dashboards sliced by customer tier and canary vs prod. Will adding a 'tier' label be practical? Concerned about label cardinality.

alex_runtime: 'tier' is low-cardinality (4 values) so we can add route_tier label at emit-time (cost ok). We'll avoid route_id at emit-time; we can annotate routes in the ingest pipeline if needed.

sre_oncall: For SRE, we'd like default alerting: hit_rate < 75% for high-throughput workloads, eviction_rate > 1%/min, and reuse_by_workload dropping >30% vs rolling baseline. We need per-workload baselines.

ben_infra: Ownership proposal: runtime emits metrics + limited labels; eng-infra owns ingestion, recording rules, and derived metrics; devex/platform (maria) owns dashboard UX & widgets; product (olivia) sets SLO thresholds; oncall (sre) owns alerts. Agree? :thumbsup:

maria_platform: Agreed. Dashboard layout suggestion: Top row = global hit_rate, eviction_rate, cache_size (single numbers + sparkline). Next row = heatmap of reuse_by_workload (workload x time). Below = time series per workload, and a table of top-10 workloads by eviction rate. Add raw counters panel for debugging.

joni_obs: Implementation notes: we'll add a recording rule in metrics-pipeline repo to compute hit_rate per workload: 
```
record: kv_cache:hit_rate:ratio
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (workload) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (workload)
```
We'll also add a job to enrich metrics with route->tier mapping if runtime doesn't emit it. Need sample queries for the dashboard.

alex_runtime: Plan/ETA: PR to runtime to add emitters + tests, behind feature-flag `emit_kv_metrics`. Will target staging in 2w. We'll try to include `workload`, `model`, and `tier` labels only. If we see cardinality blow up in staging, we'll iterate.

olivia_product: Can devex produce a mock Grafana JSON/dashboard for stakeholders before metrics land? A screenshot + query examples is enough for sign-off.

maria_platform: Yes — we can create a mock using synthetic time series (devex). joni — can you stand up a staging scrape so we can hook the mock panels to real-looking data?

joni_obs: Yep. I'll provision a staging scrape + temporary recording rules and push a grafana folder link here when ready. Will also add retention note: we should keep per-workload retention 30d, aggregated 90d.

metrics-bot: metric:kvcache.hits emitted from runtime-staging-2

ben_infra: Next steps (action items):
- alex_runtime: open runtime PR (assign to maria_platform + joni_obs) — include metric names + label docs.
- joni_obs: staging ingest + early recording rules, provide PromQL examples.
- maria_platform: draft mock dashboard and panels for review.
- olivia_product: propose SLO numbers and list of critical workloads.
I'll create a short RFC/ownership doc and a small ownership board entry. Thanks all. :rocket:
